test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Kiara will sign all the documents tomorrow.

options.text: Kiara was to be signed by tomorrow for all the documents.
Tomorrow Kiara will be signed by all the documents.
All the documents will be signed by Kiara tomorrow.
Kiara would have been signed tomorrow by all the documents.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****All the documents will be signed by Kiara tomorrow.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **active voice.** As per the question we have to change it into** passive voice.**
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• **Subject + will + infinitive + Object (Active voice)**
 
• **Subject (objective case) + will + be + past participle + by Object (subjective case) (Passive voice)**
 
 
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• *I will give you a present. (Active voice)*
 
• *A present will be given to you by me. (Passive voice)*
 
 
 
• The **subject **of the given sentence is ‘Kiara’.
 
• The **object **of the given subject is ‘the documents’.
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• **will sign **will be changed to **will be signed**.

**Correct sentence**__ - *All the documents will be signed by Kiara tomorrow.*
